advancements.survivalreimagined.framing_: Craft a Framing Table to customize the look of your Storage Drawers
advancements.survivalreimagined.capture_: Craft a Capture Net to catch small critters like Butterflies, Snails and Bees
advancements.survivalreimagined.catch_bu: Catch a Butterfly with a Capture Net in forests or plains. Butterflies pollinate flowers and help crops grow
advancements.survivalreimagined.froglass: Let a Frog eat a Dragonfly, found in swamps, to get Froglass, a colored glass block
Craft a Whistle to make your pets follow you or wander freely
advancements.survivalreimagined.knapsack: Craft a Knapsack from Hide, dropped by Boars, Rhinos, Elephants and Komodo Dragons, to carry a baby animal and release it elsewhere
advancements.survivalreimagined.shellsto: Snails drop Snail Shells: craft them with Calcite into Shellstone, a decorative stone
advancements.survivalreimagined.glow_goo: Smelt Glow Berries or kill a Firefly to get Glow Goop. Place it for light or turn it into Spectral Arrows at a Fletching Table
advancements.survivalreimagined.cooked_m: Mammoths in snowy biomes drop Mammoth Meat: cook and eat it for a meal as filling as a Steak
advancements.survivalreimagined.crab_cla: Coconuts can release a Coconut Crab when they break. Its Claw works as Shears and gives +1 reach when held
advancements.survivalreimagined.tropical: Eat a Tropical Stew, a very filling meal made from a Coconut Slice and Cooked Crab Meat
advancements.survivalreimagined.coconut_: Break a Coconut with an Axe for Coconut Slices. Eating one clears all effects and leaves a Husk, usable as a Bowl
advancements.survivalreimagined.exotic_s: Craft Coconut or Walnut Leaves with Shears to get a sapling. Coconut trees grow on beaches, Walnut trees in plains
advancements.survivalreimagined.seashell: Collect Seashells on beaches and craft them into Seashell Tiles, a decorative block
advancements.survivalreimagined.prickly_: Prickly Pears grow on fully grown Cacti. They cure Wither, but eating them raw hurts: cook them first
emi.info.supplementaries.wind_vane.1: Spins with the weather and emits a redstone signal: weak when raining, stronger when thundering, and briefly when hit by a Wind Charge.
emi.info.supplementaries.wind_vane.2: Also strongly powers the block below it, so it works well on rooftops.
emi.info.supplementaries.cog_block: A solid block that carries redstone like dust: power one and it powers the Cog Blocks next to it, losing strength along the way. Great for compact vertical wiring.
emi.info.supplementaries.crystal_display: Shows a number or symbol based on the redstone signal strength it receives. Displays placed side by side can be chained to show bigger numbers.
emi.info.supplementaries.relayer.1: Copies the signal in front of it to its back, with a tiny delay. Works with indirect power from redstone dust too.
emi.info.supplementaries.relayer.2: Carries analog signals without loss, and chains of Relayers can sit next to each other without interfering: ideal for arrays of Crystal Displays.
emi.info.supplementaries.grouper.1: Compares the blocks on its two sides and outputs from its back: a full signal if they are identical (state included), a weaker one if they are the same block in a different state (e.g. crops at different ages).
emi.info.supplementaries.grouper.2: If neither side has a full face towards it, it compares entities instead: the same type gives a weaker signal, the same item, variant, color, profession or name gives a full one.
emi.info.supplementaries.spring_launcher: Extends like a piston when powered, launching entities on top of it much farther than a piston and slime block. It can't push blocks.
Falling on an extended one from high enough bounces you up, and standing on it lets you jump slightly higher.
emi.info.supplementaries.speaker_block.1: When powered, sends a message in chat (or through the narrator) to players within its radius. Edit the message and volume from its GUI.
emi.info.supplementaries.speaker_block.2: Rename it in an Anvil to change the name shown in chat.
emi.info.supplementaries.turn_table.1: When powered, rotates the block it faces: the stronger the signal, the faster it rotates. A short pulse rotates it once.
emi.info.supplementaries.turn_table.2: Right-click to reverse the direction. Facing up, it also spins entities standing on it, and rotating a container shuffles its content.
emi.info.supplementaries.turn_table.3: Turns Pulleys connected to its axis.
emi.info.supplementaries.pulley_block.1: Holds Ropes or Chains in its single slot. When rotated by a Turn Table or a Crank, it unwinds them or winds them back up depending on the direction, carrying the block attached at the end.
emi.info.supplementaries.pulley_block.2: Rotates adjacent Pulleys on the same axis, and nearby chained Pulleys can pass ropes to each other, even horizontally.
emi.info.supplementaries.clock_block.1: Shows the current in-game time; right-click it to read the time. A Comparator reads the time of day, and it gives an observer update every in-game hour.
emi.info.supplementaries.clock_block.2: Unlike Daylight Detectors it isn't fooled by rain, but it doesn't work in the Nether or the End.
emi.info.supplementaries.dispenser_minec: A Minecart carrying a Dispenser that fires its content while it rides on a powered Activator Rail.
emi.info.supplementaries.bellows.1: When powered, blows air in front of it at a speed based on the signal: pushes entities, speeds up furnaces next to it, keeps nearby fire alive and speeds up copper oxidation.
emi.info.supplementaries.bellows.2: Compresses when stepped on. Blowing on a wet Sponge touching a Soap Block makes bubbles.
emi.info.supplementaries.redstone_illumi: A light that is on by default and gets dimmer the stronger the redstone signal it receives.
emi.info.supplementaries.crank: An analog lever: each turn changes its redstone signal. Right-click to turn it clockwise, sneak right-click for counterclockwise. Can also turn Pulleys.
emi.info.supplementaries.faucet.1: Right-click its handle to open or close it; a redstone signal inverts its state.
emi.info.supplementaries.faucet.2: Open, it drops items from the inventory below one at a time, or pours fluids from the block behind it (cauldrons, jars, waterlogged blocks, beehives...) into the container below, a bit at a time.
emi.info.supplementaries.faucet.3: It can also wet concrete powder, turn dirt into mud and void fluids into sponges.
emi.info.supplementaries.hourglass.1: Fill it with sand, dust, powder, slime or honey: the content slowly falls, with a duration based on the material, and a Comparator reads the remaining time.
emi.info.supplementaries.hourglass.2: Reset it by sneak right-clicking or by rotating it twice with a Turn Table.
emi.info.supplementaries.lock_block: Can be locked with a Key. Emits a redstone pulse when a player with the correct Key interacts with it.
emi.info.supplementaries.sconce_lever: A Sconce that works as a Lever. When unlit, its behaviour is inverted.
emi.info.supplementaries.cannon.1: Shoots any item: blocks are placed where they land and projectiles are fired as entities. The more power, the more Gunpowder each shot uses. Fire it with Flint and Steel, a gunpowder trail or redstone.
emi.info.supplementaries.cannon.2: Sneak right-click (or the maneuver button) to aim: move the mouse to aim, scroll to change power, Space to switch aiming mode, left-click to fire, E or Sneak to exit. The trajectory shows where the shot will land.
emi.info.supplementaries.cannon.3: Shooting a Void Pearl teleports you. With no ammo, sneak right-click its muzzle with an empty hand to climb inside.
emi.info.supplementaries.cannonball.1: Cannon ammo that breaks blocks based on its kinetic energy, slowing down with each block depending on its hardness. Bounces off the ground at steep angles and transfers energy to entities it hits.
emi.info.supplementaries.cannonball.2: Killing a Creeper in one hit with a Cannonball makes it drop a music disc.
emi.info.supplementaries.enderman_head: When worn, gives you the vision you'd get spectating a Voidman. Placed, it opens its mouth and emits a redstone signal while you stare at it, stronger the longer you look.
Brighter than candles. Place on floors, walls or ceilings and stack them to make candelabras and chandeliers.
Light them with Flint and Steel, Fire Charges, flaming arrows or gunpowder trails; put them out with a Shovel or water.
emi.info.supplementaries.sconces: Decorative alternatives to torches. Light them with Flint and Steel, Fire Charges, flaming arrows or gunpowder trails; water or a Splash Water Bottle puts them out without breaking them.
emi.info.supplementaries.awnings.1: Right-click with an empty hand to tilt it. Falling on one makes you bounce off depending on its angle, and sneaking on it lets you fall through.
emi.info.supplementaries.awnings.2: Can be placed on the top or bottom half of a block, against supporting blocks or other Awnings.
emi.info.supplementaries.pedestal.1: Displays one item on top; swords, tools and tridents get special poses. Stacked Pedestals connect visually.
emi.info.supplementaries.pedestal.2: Taking or placing an item gives an observer update, useful for traps.
emi.info.supplementaries.flags.1: Horizontal banners that wave in the wind, with their own set of pattern textures. Crafted from Banners.
emi.info.supplementaries.flags.2: Placed on top of a pole of placed Sticks, they can be raised and lowered.
emi.info.supplementaries.buntings: Colorful decorations that sway in the wind. Place them on Ropes, walls or ceilings.
emi.info.supplementaries.presents: Holds one item stack. From its GUI you can address it to a player and add a short description: once packed, only you and the recipient can open it.
emi.info.supplementaries.pignata.1: Hangs when placed under a block and can be tied to a Lead. Right-click with items to stuff it (hoppers work too).
emi.info.supplementaries.pignata.2: Bursts after taking enough damage (fall damage included), dropping its content. Slowly heals over time.
emi.info.supplementaries.slidy_block: Right-click to push it. It keeps sliding on ice and changes direction randomly on Soap Blocks.
emi.info.supplementaries.soap_block: Entities walking on it slip. A Bellows blowing on a wet Sponge touching it makes bubbles.
emi.info.supplementaries.sugar_cube: Dissolves when it touches water or rain. Feeding it to a horse gives it a short speed boost.
emi.info.supplementaries.gravel_bricks: Breaks when jumped or fallen on. The Suspicious variant can hide an item, like Suspicious Gravel.
emi.info.supplementaries.notice_board: Displays a Written Book, a Map or a Banner Pattern. Books show one page at a time, and a redstone pulse turns the page. Wax it to prevent interactions.
emi.info.supplementaries.fodder: Hungry farm animals eat its layers: babies grow faster and adults go into love mode (with the usual cooldown). Can be placed by Dispensers; use a Hoe to remove a layer.
emi.info.supplementaries.bamboo_spikes.1: Slow down and damage mobs walking through them.
emi.info.supplementaries.bamboo_spikes.2: Infuse them with a harmful Lingering Potion by crafting, clicking on them or pouring it with a Faucet to apply its effect too.
emi.info.supplementaries.hat_stand: Like an Armor Stand, but only holds a helmet. Sneak right-click with an empty hand to wobble it.
emi.info.supplementaries.lumisene.1: A finite, glowing liquid made of layers: it spreads out as thin as possible and floats on water. A Bucket picks up or places a full block's worth of connected layers.
emi.info.supplementaries.lumisene.2: Sets on fire instantly across all connected blocks. Walking through it gives Flammable (fire lasts longer and you spread it as you walk); drinking a bottle gives Glowing and Flammable.
emi.info.supplementaries.planter: Grows any plant or crop without water, even in the Nether, and crops on it can't be trampled.
emi.info.supplementaries.blackboard.1: Draw black and white pictures on it from its GUI, or directly by clicking with a dye (not consumed). Accepts Glow Ink.
emi.info.supplementaries.blackboard.2: Keeps its drawing when broken and can be copied like Banners. Clean it with a wet Sponge or Soap; wax it to prevent interactions.
emi.info.supplementaries.timber_frames: Frames, Braces and Cross Braces can hold any solid block: click a placed one with the block. An Axe breaks the frame and leaves the block.
emi.info.supplementaries.daub: A medieval building block: placed inside a Timber Frame, Brace or Cross Brace, it becomes Wattle and Daub.
emi.info.supplementaries.netherite_doors: Can be locked with a Key: once locked, only players with the correct Key can open them. Anyone can use them until they are locked.
emi.info.supplementaries.gold_doors: While powered by redstone, they can't be opened or closed by hand.
emi.info.supplementaries.iron_gate: A sturdier Fence Gate that connects visually to the gates above and below it.
emi.info.supplementaries.rope.1: Place it under a ceiling, on fences or walls or next to other Ropes; like Scaffolding, it only reaches so far horizontally. Vertical Ropes are climbable and stop fall damage; horizontal ones can be walked on, slowly.
emi.info.supplementaries.rope.2: Place a Rope against a vertical one to extend it down, pushing the block at its end; sneak right-click with an empty hand to pull it up, lifting that block (great for wells). Shears remove the bottom connection.
emi.info.supplementaries.rope.3: Burns quickly and breaks when hit by projectiles, along with the Ropes it supports.
emi.info.supplementaries.flint_block: Pushed by a Piston against an iron-like block (or vice versa), it makes sparks that set nearby flammable blocks on fire. Walking on it with Iron Boots does the same.
emi.info.supplementaries.feather_block: Extremely fluffy: you sink slowly into it and take no fall damage.
emi.info.supplementaries.doormat: Holds a few lines of text, and cats like to sit on it. Sneak right-click one of its sides to hide an item under it.
emi.info.supplementaries.way_signs.1: Up to two can be placed on a fence or placed Stick, or against a wall. They point where you face when placing them; sneak right-click to flip one.
emi.info.supplementaries.way_signs.2: Click it with a Compass to point it towards the Compass target. Can be dyed like signs.
emi.info.supplementaries.flower_box: Holds flowers and plants, including tall ones and vines. Can be placed on the side or middle of a block, or hanging from a ceiling.
emi.info.supplementaries.statue: Holds an item in its hand; candles, tools and swords have special poses. Waves when powered by redstone.
emi.info.supplementaries.goblet: Holds and displays a drink: potions, honey, milk, soups and more. Right-click to drink it instantly. Readable by Comparators.
emi.info.supplementaries.jar.1: Holds cookie-like foods, which you can eat straight from it, or bottles of a liquid like a Goblet.
emi.info.supplementaries.jar.2: It can also capture small creatures: click one with the Jar.
emi.info.supplementaries.slingshot: Shoots blocks, which place themselves where they land when possible. Can be enchanted with Quick Charge and Multishot.
emi.info.supplementaries.quiver.1: Holds several stacks of different arrows; add them by clicking a stack onto it like a Bundle. Arrows you pick up go inside if it has room for them.
emi.info.supplementaries.quiver.2: Use it to pick the arrow to shoot (with the mouse, arrow keys, number keys or the scroll wheel) without slowing down, or sneak right-click to cycle.
emi.info.supplementaries.quiver.3: Some Skeletons spawn with one on higher difficulties, shoot tipped arrows and can drop it.
emi.info.supplementaries.confetti_popper: Makes confetti! Can be worn as a party hat (Creepers can wear them too). Sneak to place a layer on the ground.
emi.info.supplementaries.cannon_boats: A Boat with a Cannon. Press Ctrl to fire while driving, or Space to enter maneuver mode.
emi.info.supplementaries.altimeter: Its texture shows your height and changes with the dimension. Right-click to see your Y level.
emi.info.supplementaries.slice_map: A Map showing the world as seen at the Y level where it was created, with a smaller range. You need to be at that level to map it, so it can't be used as X-ray.
emi.info.supplementaries.flute.1: Click a pet or horse to bind it to the Flute, then play it to call nearby bound pets that aren't sitting.
emi.info.supplementaries.flute.2: Plays a random song; rename it to a song's name to always play that one.
emi.info.supplementaries.wrench.1: Rotates nearly any block, including signs, chests and beds, around the axis of the clicked face; sneak right-click to reverse. Left-click to rotate Item Frames and Armor Stands.
emi.info.supplementaries.wrench.2: Also a fast melee weapon, as strong as a Wooden Sword.
emi.info.supplementaries.soap.1: Craft it with dyed items to remove their color, or use it on dyed blocks, armor, pets, Sheep and Slimes to wash them.
emi.info.supplementaries.soap.2: Removes wax and oxidation from copper in one use, and cleans Blackboards, Maps, Sticky Pistons, tipped Bamboo Spikes and more. Also washes away the Slimed effect.
emi.info.supplementaries.bombs.1: Thrown projectiles that explode where they land, damaging mobs while only breaking weak blocks like grass. They can ignite nearby Creepers.
emi.info.supplementaries.bombs.2: Blue Bombs, found while exploring, flash before going off, then deal heavy area damage, set entities on fire and inflict Weakness.
emi.info.supplementaries.rope_arrow.1: Deploys a coil of Ropes where it lands, great for exploring caves. Holds a limited number of Ropes: craft it in the Fletching Table and refill it with Ropes in the crafting grid.
emi.info.supplementaries.rope_arrow.2: Ropes it didn't place stay in the arrow, so pick it back up.
emi.info.supplementaries.bubble_blower: Blows soap bubbles at your friends. Recharge it by crafting it with Soap.
emi.info.supplementaries.antique_ink: Found in Urns and fishing. Use it on a sign to give it an antique font; craft it with a Map for an Antique Map, or with a Written Book for a Tattered Book that can't be copied.
emi.info.supplementaries.key.1: Rename it in an Anvil to set a password, then click a Netherite Door, Netherite Trapdoor or Lock Block to lock it. Sneak right-click with the correct Key to unlock it.
emi.info.supplementaries.key.2: To open a locked block the Key only needs to be in your inventory. Dispensers can use it too.
emi.info.supplementaries.candy: A sweet that is very quick to eat. Eating too many at once has side effects.
emi.info.supplementaries.pancake.1: Like cakes, eaten once placed. Stack them in a pile and top them with Honey (by clicking or with a Faucet) for a short Speed boost when eaten.
emi.info.supplementaries.pancake.2: Put one in a Jukebox for some sick tunes!
emi.info.supplementaries.music_discs: Pancake: play a Pancake in a Jukebox. Heave Ho: kill a Creeper in one hit with a Cannonball.
emi.info.supplementaries.flax: A tall crop used for Ropes, Fodder, Doormats and more.
emi.info.supplementaries.urn: Found in small patches deep underground. Breaking one drops loot, usually bones or ores but rarely something great like bombs or enchanted gear. Fortune improves the loot.
emi.info.supplementaries.placeable_gunpo: Gunpowder can be placed on the ground as a trail. Light it with fire, Fire Charges, flaming arrows or lava: it burns along the trail and ignites TNT, flammable blocks, campfires and candles.
emi.info.supplementaries.throwable_brick: Bricks can be thrown at your foes, and break glass blocks they hit.
emi.info.supplementaries.throwable_slime: Slimeballs can be thrown and bounce off anything. Hit entities get the Slimed effect, which lowers their jump height until it wears off or is washed away with water or Soap. Slimes can apply it too.
emi.info.supplementaries.placeable_stick: Sticks and Blaze Rods can be placed on the ground, a few per block. Placed Blaze Rods burn entities standing on them and bubble underwater.
emi.info.supplementaries.raked_gravel: Use a Hoe on Gravel to rake it in the direction you are facing. It can go in any direction and curve.
emi.info.supplementaries.placeable_books: Books can be placed on the ground: normal books stand side by side with random colors, enchanted ones are piled up.
emi.info.supplementaries.zombie_horse: Feeding a lot of Rotten Flesh to a tamed Skeleton Horse slowly turns it into a Zombie Horse, which can be ridden underwater.
emi.info.supplementaries.item_lore: Craft a renamed Name Tag with any item to add its name as lore to the item.
emi.info.supplementaries.clock: Right-click a Clock to see the current time.
emi.info.amendments.lanterns: Lanterns can be placed on walls, where they swing when hit by entities. Lanterns hanging from a ceiling fall if their support is broken.
emi.info.amendments.cauldron.1: Cauldrons can hold any liquid. Click one with an item to craft it with the liquid inside, or throw the ingredients in.
emi.info.amendments.cauldron.2: Mix potions in it, or dye its water with dyes (dyed water can be mixed too) and fill Dye Bottles from it.
emi.info.amendments.cauldron.3: With a heat source below, water and potions boil and hurt whoever stands in them. A boiling water cauldron can cook stews from the ingredients thrown in. Walking into a splash or lingering potion applies it.
emi.info.amendments.dye_bottle: Dyed water taken from a Cauldron. Pour it into a Cauldron to dye its water.
emi.info.amendments.lectern: Placing a Book and Quill on it opens a writing screen with a Quill button to change font and an Ink Well button to change text color. Works with Hoppers.
emi.info.amendments.hanging_signs: Hanging Signs can hold an item (or a Banner Pattern) on each face. Attached to walls they swing, and they connect visually to fences and walls.
emi.info.amendments.carpets: Carpets can be placed on Slabs and Stairs.
emi.info.amendments.mob_heads: Mob heads can be stacked on top of each other in any combination, and you can place one or more Candles on them.
emi.info.amendments.lily_pad: Any block can be placed on a Lily Pad: it becomes a waterlogged block with the Lily Pad on top, and goes back to normal when removed.
emi.info.amendments.bell: Ring a Bell by interacting with the Chains or Ropes hanging below it, even long ones.
emi.info.amendments.ceiling_decor: Banners and Flower Pots can be placed on ceilings.
emi.info.amendments.tripwire_hook: Sneak right-click a placed Tripwire Hook with a tool to hang it there.
emi.info.amendments.fire_charge.1: Fire Charges can be thrown and are affected by gravity. They set things on fire where they land.
emi.info.amendments.fire_charge.2: Dragon Charges are a Dragon's Breath version that leaves a lingering cloud. Dispensers shoot both.
emi.info.amendments.torch: Hitting a mob with a Torch in your main hand sets it on fire for a moment.
emi.info.amendments.jukebox: Jukeboxes show the disc they are playing, which spins while the music plays.
emi.info.clayworks.kiln: A furnace for building materials: it bakes Bricks, Terracotta, Glass, smooth and cracked stones and similar blocks faster than a Furnace, using the same fuels.
emi.info.clayworks.pottery_table: Used to customize Decorated Pots: change their color with a Dye, or add a trim by choosing a pattern and a trim material (Iron, Copper, Gold, Lapis, Amethyst, Diamond, Emerald, Netherite...).
emi.info.boatload.furnace_boat: A boat with a Furnace that burns fuel to go faster. Sneak right-click it to open the fuel slot. The Furnace takes a seat, so it carries only one passenger.
emi.info.boatload.large_boat: A wider boat that carries more passengers, or fewer if some of them are large mobs.
emi.info.bitsandbalance.glow_goo.1: Throw it to leave a bright Glow Goo Splatter where it lands, which works as a light source even underwater. Mobs and players hit by it glow for a while.
emi.info.bitsandbalance.glow_goo.2: Brewed into a Potion of Glowing (made from Glow Berries), it gives a Potion of Bioluminescence, which makes you emit light.
emi.info.bitsandbalance.music_disc_dog: Dropped by Creepers killed by a Skeleton, like the other Music Discs, and found in some chests.
emi.info.hangglider.hang_glider: Right-click to open it, then jump from a high place to glide. Sneak to dive faster. It loses durability quickly while gliding and is repaired with Phantom Membranes in an Anvil.
emi.info.sawmill.sawmill: A Stonecutter for wood: put in Logs or Planks and choose any wooden item to make it directly, often for fewer planks than the crafting recipe.
emi.info.labels.label.1: Like an Item Frame, but it fits on any surface and lets you open the block behind it, perfect for chests and storage.
emi.info.labels.label.2: Sneak right-click it with an item to show that item. Dye it to change its color, use a Glow Ink Sac to make it glow, or a Feather to show the item's name.
emi.info.strawstatues.straw_statue.1: A player-shaped armor stand that can wear armor and hold items. Sneak while placing it for a random pose.
emi.info.strawstatues.straw_statue.2: Sneak right-click it with an empty hand to open its menu, where you can change its pose, size, rotation and the skin of any player by name. Right-clicking it with a Player Head also gives it that player's skin.
emi.info.gravestone.gravestone.1: When you die, a Grave with all your items is placed where you died. Break it to get your items back in their original slots. Right-click it to see who died there and when.
emi.info.gravestone.gravestone.2: Graves can also be crafted and renamed in an Anvil to show a custom text.
emi.info.storagedrawers.drawers.1: Stores a large amount of a single item in each slot, shown on its front. Right-click with an item to put it in, or double right-click to put in all of that item from your inventory. Left-click to take a single item, sneak left-click to take a stack. Hoppers can insert and extract items.
emi.info.storagedrawers.drawers.2: Each slot holds many stacks, fewer the more slots the Drawer has. Half Drawers hold half as much. Drawers keep their items when broken.
emi.info.storagedrawers.framing_table: Changes the look of Drawers and Trims: put one in with a full block for the sides, and optionally other blocks for the trim and the front, to get a Framed version that looks like those blocks.
emi.info.shieldsplus.shields.1: Shields block a fixed amount of damage per hit, shown in their tooltip, and the rest goes through. They only block attacks from the front, and Axes disable them for a moment.
emi.info.shieldsplus.shields.2: A shield can stay lifted only for a limited time, then it goes on cooldown, longer the more it was lifted. Raising it right before being hit is a parry, which blocks more damage.
emi.info.shieldsplus.shields.3: With a shield in the off hand, crouch to block. You can attack while crouch blocking, but each attack puts the shield on cooldown for a moment.
emi.info.ecologics.coconut.1: Coconuts grow on Coconut trees and fall when ripe, hurting whoever they land on. Most smash on the ground, dropping Coconut Slices, and sometimes a Coconut Crab comes out. Some land intact, always when falling into water.
emi.info.ecologics.coconut.2: A placed Coconut can be broken with an Axe to open it into Coconut Slices.
emi.info.ecologics.coconut_slice: Eating a Coconut Slice removes all your effects, like Milk, and leaves a Coconut Husk, which can be used instead of a Bowl for stews.
emi.info.ecologics.crab_claw: Dropped by Coconut Crabs. It works as a pair of Shears with low durability, and lets you reach farther while held in the main hand.
emi.info.ecologics.sandcastle.1: Place it on Sand, or use it on Turtle Eggs to put them inside. Eggs in a Sandcastle are safe from mobs and hatch much faster.
emi.info.ecologics.sandcastle.2: Only players can break it by walking or jumping on it, which leaves the Turtle Eggs behind.
emi.info.ecologics.maple_syrup.1: Place a Spile on a Sappy Maple Log and hang a Bucket on it: it slowly fills with Maple Sap. When the Bucket is full, the log may run out of sap and turn into a normal Maple Log.
emi.info.ecologics.maple_syrup.2: Pour the Maple Sap into a Cauldron over a heat source (fire, a lit Campfire or Furnace, Magma, Lava...) and let it boil down, then fill a Glass Bottle with the Maple Syrup. The boiling sap hurts whoever stands in it.
emi.info.ecologics.prickly_pear: Prickly Pears grow on top of fully grown Cacti and can be planted on Cacti. Eating one cures Wither, but raw ones prick you.
emi.info.ecologics.pot.1: Click it with an item to drop one inside, until it's full. They can't be taken out: they drop when the Pot is broken.
emi.info.ecologics.pot.2: Each item put inside emits a redstone pulse, and Comparators read how many items it holds. Sneak right-click it with a Pickaxe to change its carving.
emi.info.ecologics.thin_ice: Thin Ice cracks when players and most mobs walk on it, and breaks into water after a few steps. Falling on it without Feather Falling cracks it and the ice around it.
emi.info.ecologics.penguin_feather: Dropped by baby Penguins when they grow up. Brewed into an Awkward Potion, it makes a Potion of Sliding, which makes you slide on any block as if it were ice.
emi.info.naturalist.capture_net.1: Use it on small critters like Butterflies, Caterpillars, Dragonflies, Fireflies, Bees, Ants, Snails, Crabs, Rats, Scorpions and Hedgehogs to catch them as an item. Use the item on a block to release the critter.
emi.info.naturalist.capture_net.2: With a Water Bucket in your inventory, it can also catch Cod into a Bucket of Cod. A caught Hedgehog can be thrown: it rolls into a ball and hurts whatever it hits.
emi.info.naturalist.knapsack: Use it on a baby animal to carry it inside, then use it on a block to release it there.
emi.info.naturalist.whistle: Use it on one of your tamed animals to switch between following you and wandering freely.
emi.info.naturalist.ant_hill.1: Breaking the Ant Hill chamber where the queen lives drops a Queen Ant. Breaking a chamber with ants inside makes them come out and attack you.
emi.info.naturalist.ant_hill.2: Use a Queen Ant on the ground to start your own Ant Hill. Its ants gather food lying around and store it inside, dropping it when the chamber is broken, and come out to defend you when you fight nearby.
emi.info.naturalist.glow_goop: Made by smelting Glow Berries, and dropped by Fireflies. Place it to light up an area, even underwater; stacking more in the same spot makes it brighter. It can also be turned into Spectral Arrows at the Fletching Table.
emi.info.naturalist.froglass: Dropped when a Frog eats a Dragonfly. Its color depends on the Dragonfly's.
emi.info.naturalist.snail_shell: Dropped by Snails. Place it as a decoration, dye it in the crafting grid, or put a small plant in it like in a Flower Pot. Crafted with Calcite into Shellstone.
emi.info.naturalist.starfish: Dropped by Starfish. It can be placed on any side of a block, even underwater.
emi.info.naturalist.antler: Dropped by Deer. Brewed into an Awkward Potion, it makes a Potion of the Forest Dasher, which gives Speed and Weakness.
emi.info.naturalist.scorpion_poison_glan: Dropped by Scorpions. Brewed into an Awkward Potion, it makes a Potion of Antivenom, which cures Poison.
emi.info.naturalist.hide: Dropped by Boars, Rhinos, Elephants and Komodo Dragons. Craft it into a Knapsack, or smelt it into Leather.
emi.info.naturalist.fur: Shear an adult Bear to get it without hurting it: the fur grows back over time. Also dropped by Lions, Tigers and Mammoths.
emi.info.naturalist.eggs: Laid by Alligators, Tortoises and Ostriches after breeding. They hatch over time, but can break when walked or fallen on. Only Silk Touch picks them up.
emi.info.naturalist.duck_egg: Laid by Ducks. Throw it to sometimes hatch a Duckling, or use it instead of an Egg in Cakes and Pumpkin Pies.
emi.info.naturalist.chrysalis: Caterpillars turn into a Chrysalis on the side of a log, which later hatches into a Butterfly. Only Shears or Silk Touch pick it up.
emi.info.naturalist.music_discs: "Wild Ones" is sometimes carried by Foxes. "Death by Hogs" is sometimes dropped by Boars when they kill a player.
